# Executor

[Git Source](https://github.com/robotmoney/robotmoney-core/blob/aae683920cd57dc96d920c3e2d788e226f098aef/contracts/test/vendor/safe-1.4.1/base/Executor.sol)

**Title:** Executor - A contract that can execute transactions

**Author:** Richard Meissner - @rmeissner

## Functions

<a id="execute-address-uint256-bytes-enum-operation-uint256"></a>

### execute

Executes either a delegatecall or a call with provided parameters.

<i>

This method doesn't perform any sanity check of the transaction, such as:
     - if the contract at `to` address has code or not
     It is the responsibility of the caller to perform such checks.

</i>

```solidity
function execute(
        address to,
        uint256 value,
        bytes memory data,
        Enum.Operation operation,
        uint256 txGas
    ) internal returns (bool success);
```

**Parameters**

| Name | Type | Description |
| ---- | ---- | ----------- |
| to | `address` | Destination address. |
| value | `uint256` | Ether value. |
| data | `bytes` | Data payload. |
| operation | `Enum.Operation` | Operation type. |
| txGas | `uint256` |  |

**Returns**

| Name | Type | Description |
| ---- | ---- | ----------- |
| success | `bool` | boolean flag indicating if the call succeeded. |
